sloka: अभिवृष्टः शरौघेण मेघेनेव महाचलः ।ह्रस्वं कृत्वा तदा रूपं ध्वजाग्रे निपपात ह ।। ६.५९.७९ ।।।।
transliteration: abhivṛṣṭaḥ śaraugheṇa megheneva mahācalaḥ ।hrasvaṁ kṛtvā tadā rūpaṁ dhvajāgre nipapāta ha ।। 6.59.79 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana broke those trees in return and showered rain of formidable arrows at Neela.
